title: The edited test 'HTTP /ask with an empty or undefined resolved tenant' is now vacuous: requireAuth refuses first, so every no-data/no-query assertion holds trivially and nothing asserts the ask route / tree store still refuse an empty or operator-object tenant if auth is bypassed or changed
area: apps/api/src/ask/ask-tenant-isolation.test.ts:331-343 (expected status 404 -> 401); apps/api/src/routes/ask/ask.ts:44-46 (route passes req.auth.tenantId to tree.load unvalidated)
evidence: Probe on 34e6747: createAskRouter mounted behind a stub middleware setting req.auth={tenantId:T}; T="" -> 404 with tree.load(""); T=undefined -> 404 with tree.load(undefined); T={"$ne":null} -> 404 with tree.load({"$ne":null}). The route itself validates nothing; the 404 depends entirely on the tree store finding no row. The edited HTTP test can no longer reach the route (401), so its assertions db.queries==[] and returned==0 pass with or without any deeper protection. Remaining deeper tests (arms at :203, hydrator at :244) cover the arms and hydrator accessors only, not the route or tree store.
fix_direction: Restore a route-level assertion that bypasses auth: mount createAskRouter (or call the handler) with req.auth.tenantId in ["", undefined, {$ne:null}] and assert no turns/chunks query, no rows returned, no model call, and a refusal (404/401/400); keep the 401 HTTP assertion as an additional test. Optionally validate req.auth.tenantId in the route.
reproduction: Probe above (createAskRouter + stub auth middleware, POST /ask {query:"q"}).
note: Fix-cycle item for this unit (verdict rule: edit weakened the suite). Test repair only; no source change required.

title: Several tenant-filter sites build {tenantId} by hand outside scopedCollection/withTenant and carry no validation of their own; they are protected only by requireAuth
area: apps/api/src/store.ts:61,141,210,222,234 (api_keys find/insertOne/updateOne; tree_index findOne via treeIndexRootFilter); apps/api/src/indexing/session.ts:32,265; packages/index/src/tree/build.ts:49 treeIndexRootFilter; apps/api/src/whatsapp/store.ts:147,162,181 (replaceOne/bulkWrite filters); apps/api/src/activity-health/queue-reader.ts:33 (env tenant, trimmed only); scripts/mint-key.mjs:42 deleteMany({tenantId,label}) from CLI
evidence: git grep of .find/.updateOne/.replaceOne/.deleteMany with tenantId. Tenant origin: req.auth.tenantId (validated by this unit) in store.ts, whatsapp/store.ts, indexing via ingest-store/whatsapp; env/CLI strings elsewhere. No client-controllable path exists today (Express 5.2.1 default 'simple' query parser, no handler reads a tenant from body, query or header), so none is exploitable now. treeIndexRootFilter additionally ANDs node_id 'tenant:'+tenantId so an object tenant cannot match.
fix_direction: Export assertValidTenantId from @lkb/db and call it in treeIndexRootFilter and the api_keys store functions; or route api_keys through a scoped accessor. File-don't-fix per round cap (defence in depth).
